finish_summary:
1) bulk_discount_percent(50) returns 5% instead of expected 10% per spec for quantity >=50.
2) parse_coupon is case‑sensitive and rejects lower‑case 'save', contrary to the spec which requires case‑insensitivity.
3) Cart.remove_item does not delete an item when its quantity reaches zero, so subtotal() calls bulk_discount_percent(0) and raises ValueError; spec states items with 0 quantity should be removed entirely and no error occurs.
